cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Who Changed It?
cards.instruction: Ask innocent questions until someone admits altering the plan, schedule, arrangement, or shared space.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Interesting. The picnic moved from Saturday to Friday. Whose blue pen is that? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. And whose handwriting adds hearts to Fridays?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Now, who should tell the Saturday guests?

mechanism: A presents a calm scheduling check while softly narrowing responsibility for a picnic change, adopting B preference to keep the confession flowing.
confusable: Unlike a blunt accusation, A asks apparently procedural innocent questions; authority must accommodate the admitted change rather than punish it.
comparison: Calendar clues and notifying guests differ from domestic furniture and displaced mugs.
seedUse: Read canonical D40-a critically as a protected single exception; use its pen/Friday clue only as creative context, plus S02-a adopting another decision.
